GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2022-01-20T10:39:40Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Preload function doesn't load soft-deleted entities
Description: ## Issue Description
When i want to preload a soft deleted entity (entities with deleted_at field not null), it returns undefined.
I'm using it to update my entity, so i have a condition in order to throw an error if the preloaded entity is empty.

### Expected Behavior
I expect that the preload function returns the entity even if the entity is soft deleted.
OR
Add a parameter that allow us to load soft deleted entities

### Actual Behavior
The preload function doesn't load the soft deleted entities  and then it returns undefined.

My code:
```typescript
console.log({ id });
const project = await queryRunner.manager.preload(Project, {
        id,
        ...projectDto,
 });

console.log({ project });
if (!project) {
   throw new NotFoundException(`Project with id "${id}" not found`);
}
```
The logs:
```
{ id: '85c6d6c2-e279-4993-a0bb-53dafdaed5f2' }
{ project: undefined }
Error: Project with id "85c6d6c2-e279-4993-a0bb-53dafdaed5f2" not found
```
My entity (exported as json from my db):
```json

	{
		"id": "85c6d6c2-e279-4993-a0bb-53dafdaed5f2",

]
```

1. Create an entity with deleted_at not null in your database
2. Try to preload it
